info.name: ecom-mern — 02 Admin Catalog
info.description: Products (with 500-word descriptions & detail buckets), Product Variants, Categories, Brands, Images, and CSV Import.

item.name: Admin — Brands
item.description:
Brand management. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

request.description: Returns all brands sorted alphabetically by name.

Fetches a single brand by MongoDB ObjectId.

**Error codes:** `404` — Brand not found

Creates a new brand. The `slug` is auto-generated server-side from `name`.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 2 chars, max 100 chars

**Optional fields:**
- `logo` — valid URL string
- `isActive` — boolean (default: true)

Updates a brand. All fields are optional.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

If `name` is changed, `slug` is regenerated automatically.

**Error codes:** `404` — Brand not found

Deletes a brand.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Blocked if:** any product is currently assigned to this brand.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Brand has products assigned to it
- `404` — Brand not found

response.name: 400 Brand In Use

item.name: Admin — Categories
item.description:
Category management. Supports nested categories via the `parent` field.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

request.description: Returns all categories sorted alphabetically by name.

Fetches a single category by MongoDB ObjectId.

**Error codes:** `404` — Category not found

Creates a new category. The `slug` is auto-generated from `name`.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — string, min 2 chars, max 100 chars

**Optional fields:**
- `description` — string
- `parent` — MongoDB ObjectId of parent category (for nested categories)
- `isActive` — boolean (default: true)
- `image.url` — string
- `image.fileId` — string

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Parent category not found

Updates a category. All fields optional.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Category cannot be its own parent
- `400` — Parent category not found
- `404` — Category not found

Deletes a category.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Blocked if:**
- Category has child subcategories
- Any product is assigned to this category

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Has subcategories or products
- `404` — Category not found

item.name: Admin — Products
item.description:
Product management with variant support. All routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

**Note:** Stock is ledger-only — use `POST /api/inventory/movements` to adjust stock levels. Direct stock writes via the product/variant endpoints are intentionally blocked.

query.description: Filter by status: draft | active | archived

request.description: Returns a paginated list of products. Each product includes its populated `category`, `brand`, and `variants` array.

request.description:
Creates a new product with its variants in a single transaction.

**Description:** Up to 500 words.
**Extra Detail Modules (Optional):**
- `keyFeatures`: bullet points or highlights
- `productDimensions`: dimensions, sizing, weight

body.raw:
{
  "name": "MacBook Pro 14 (M3)",
  "description": "Updated description",
  "status": "active",
  "featured": true,
  "keyFeatures": "• Updated Key Features",
  "productDimensions": "Updated Dimensions: 25 x 20 x 5 cm"
}

request.description:
Updates product fields. **Does not modify variants** — use the variant endpoints for that.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`. All fields are optional.

**Note:** Passing `variants` in the body is silently ignored.

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Category or brand not found
- `404` — Product not found

Deletes a product and **cascade-deletes all its variants** in a single transaction.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Error codes:** `404` — Product not found

Bulk-updates `status` and/or `featured` for multiple products in one request.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `ids` — non-empty array of MongoDB ObjectIds
- `updates` — object with at least one of:
  - `status` — enum: `draft` | `active` | `archived`
  - `featured` — boolean

**Error codes:** `400` — No IDs or no valid update fields provided

Bulk-deletes products and all their variants in a transaction.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `ids` — non-empty array of MongoDB ObjectIds

**Error codes:** `400` — No product IDs provided

item.name: Admin — Product Variants
item.description:
Variant management nested under a product. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Important:** Stock cannot be changed here. Use `POST /api/inventory/movements` instead.

**Access:**
- GET: any authenticated admin role
- POST, PUT, DELETE: `super_admin` or `admin` only

request.description: Returns all variants belonging to the specified product.

Fetches a single variant by its ID.

**Error codes:** `404` — Variant not found

Adds a new variant to an existing product.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Required fields:**
- `sku` — string, globally unique
- `price` — number ≥ 0
- `stock` — integer ≥ 0

**Optional fields:**
- `barcode`, `options`, `salePrice` (must be ≤ price), `costPrice`, `weight`, `images` (max 4), `isActive`

**Note:** `product` field is automatically taken from the URL `productId` — do not send it in the body.

Updates variant fields. All fields are optional.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Cannot update:** `product` (immutable) or `stock` (use inventory endpoint).

**Error codes:** `404` — Variant not found

Deletes a variant.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Blocked if:** The variant is the product's only remaining variant (delete the product instead).

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Cannot delete the only variant
- `404` — Variant not found

response.name: 400 Last Variant

item.name: Admin — Images
item.description:
Image upload to ImageKit CDN. Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin` only.

formdata.description: Image file(s) to upload. Field name must be 'image'. Max 4 files.

request.description:
Uploads 1–4 image files to ImageKit under the `/ecommerce-admin/products` folder.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Request:** `multipart/form-data` with field name `image` (can include multiple files, max 4).

**Returns:** Array of `{ url, fileId, name }` objects — use these in the product/variant `images` array.

**Error codes:** `400` — No image files provided

item.name: Admin — CSV Import
item.description:
Import products from a Shopify-format CSV file. The workflow is:
1. `POST /import/preview` — Upload CSV, get a preview with validation
2. `POST /import/confirm` — Confirm and commit valid rows to the DB
3. `POST /import/:id/rollback` — Undo an import if needed

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.
**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin` only.

formdata.description: Shopify-format CSV file. Field name must be 'file'.

request.description:
Parses and validates a Shopify-format CSV. **No database writes.** Returns per-row validation results grouped into products.

**Required CSV columns:** Title/Handle, SKU, Price or Compare At Price

**Error codes:**
- `400` — No file provided, empty CSV, or missing required columns

response.name: 200 Success

request.description:
Re-validates and commits only the `valid: true` products from the preview response into the database. Creates an `ImportJob` record for potential rollback.

**Pass the full `products` array from the preview response** — invalid items are automatically skipped.

**Required fields:**
- `products` — array (non-empty) from preview response

**Optional fields:**
- `fileName` — string, for the ImportJob record

Undoes a completed import by deleting all products, variants, categories, and brands that were created during that import. Also cleans up ImageKit files.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Path params:**
- `importJobId` — MongoDB ObjectId of the ImportJob

**Error codes:**
- `400` — Import already rolled back
- `404` — Import job not found

response.name: 200 Success

request.description:
Returns paginated list of ImportJob records for the current user.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`.

**Query params:**
- `page`, `limit`
- `status` — `completed` | `rolled_back`

Returns a single ImportJob. Use `status` to determine if rollback is available.

**Access:** `super_admin` or `admin`. Scoped to the requesting user's own jobs.

**Error codes:** `404` — Import job not found or belongs to another user
